notes: The set coheres as one study. The thread (the mockers reciting Psalm 22; the King who would not come down) is unbroken: the scorn opens (#1), the psalmist foresaw it (#2), the proof descends through the lip/wagging-heads/rulers (#3,#4,#5) onto the enduring Christ (#6), the scorners testify unknowingly (#8), and the turn lands on held power (#10), borne scorn (#11), and the mocked King revealed (#12) who bore it FOR the mockers (#13), closing on the cross at dawn (#14). Hero #7 (the cross) bookends so it lands on Christ. No invented eyewitness, no written-scroll scene. The only soft spot is a front-half mocker-face cluster, intrinsic to the passage and offset by framing variety and the mercy turn — not a structural failure.
